a.xlink:title: Reads every sensor and publishes the results.
Reads both feedback angles (deg from the Init() zero).
Returns the last readings and voted result.
Returns the latest solution.
Returns the voted reading: acceleration in g, rate in deg/s, sensor axes.
Reads each active sensor and recomputes the voted result.
Reads each active sensor and recomputes the voted output.
Reads everything the module has buffered and parses it.
Converts readRawVoltage() to degrees relative to _zeroVoltage (360° per 3.3 V).
Reads both feedback voltages from ADC3 and smooths them.
Returns the last reading stored by Update().
Reads a new sample if one is ready and converts it to altitude.
Returns the mean of the two values that agree most closely.
Returns the last reading stored by Update().
Copies sensor A into Voted_BMI.
Votes Raw_BMI into Voted_BMI, acceleration and rate separately.
Reads a new sample if one is ready.
Returns the mean of the two vectors closest to each other (Euclidean distance).
Converts a raw gyroscope value to deg/s.
Converts a raw accelerometer value to g.
Reads the bytes-waiting count.
Reads numBytes (capped at RX_BUF_SIZE) into rxBuf.
